Activate 'K1_SHUTALARM' if ANY of the below conditions are TRUE.

Deactivate 'K1_SHUTALARM' if ALL of the below conditions are FALSE, and the CRO has RESET 'K1_SHUTALARM'.

- F14-SEQ-0005 STOPPED OR PAUSED OR
- ILR CONCENTRATE HOPPER FULL: WI14073 >= A_HH  OR
- BOWL PEGGED: PI14034 >= A_HH OR
- BOWL SPEED LOW: SI14035 <= A_Lo (MASK UNTIL F14-CO-401 RUNNING > 45 SECONDS) OR
- BOWL SPEED HIGH: SI14035 >= A_Hi OR
- MOTOR FAULT: F14CO401 TRIP FAULT - See Drives for further information OR
- MOTOR OVERLOAD: F14CO401 Overload - Current Overload OR
- HIGH VIBRATION: VI14036 >= A_HH OR
- FLOW NOT ACHIEVED (Step Specific, FIC14032) OR:
     • FIC14032.PV Not within ± 5% m3/h of SV for 20 seconds during step 4, 7, 15, 22 of F14-SEQ-0005
- DV ALARM:
     • FIC14032 > 5 m3/h when FIC14032.SV = 0

5 second on-delay on all conditions (exception 0 seconds on F14CO401 trip)
